en: Black-and-white postcard showing a panoramic view over the rooftops of a historic European town. Dominating the scene is a large church with two baroque-style towers (the cathedral), and beside it a fortified complex with round towers and a large building (a castle and courthouse). The foreground is filled with smaller townhouses and industrial chimneys. At the top in red Gothic-style script are printed captions identifying the location and buildings.
